description: Glassdoor employer reviews: overall rating, review count, sub-ratings (culture, work-life, pay, career, management, diversity), CEO approval, recommend and outlook shares, star distribution and the 3 reviews shown to logged-out visitors (title, pros, cons, job, location, date). Needs the employer's Glassdoor name and id, e.g. Apple-E1138. Via a residential proxy. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

employer.description: Employer as in its Glassdoor reviews URL: <Name>-E<id>, e.g. Apple-E1138 or Google-E9079 (from glassdoor.com/Reviews/Google-Reviews-E9079.htm); the full URL also works
